lead_raw_text:
The structure of MgMn6 (Mg2Mn12 per cell) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with 14 atoms distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows both Mg and Mn centers adopt 12-neighbor close-packed-like local arrangements, with Mg coordinated by 12 Mn neighbors and Mn by 4 Mg plus 8 Mn neighbors, all at distances of 2.88–3.09 Å. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts reveal Mn–Mn 12-vertex polyhedra sharing corners, edges, and faces, while Mg–Mn pairs share edges and corners. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 14 sites.
